category.name: Business English
category.description: Dunia kerja: rapat, negosiasi, dan komunikasi profesional.

words.definition: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
words.example: We need to negotiate the price with the supplier.
words.example_id: Kita perlu menegosiasikan harga dengan pemasok.

words.definition: The latest time by which something must be finished.
words.example: The deadline for the report is Friday.

words.definition: The money a company receives from sales.
words.example: Our revenue grew by ten percent this year.
words.example_id: Pendapatan kami naik sepuluh persen tahun ini.

words.definition: A person you work with.
words.example: My colleague helped me finish the presentation.
words.example_id: Rekan kerja saya membantu menyelesaikan presentasi.

words.definition: A document listing goods or services and the amount owed.
words.example: Please send the invoice to our finance team.
words.example_id: Mohon kirim faktur ke tim keuangan kami.

words.definition: To raise someone to a higher position or to advertise something.
words.example: She was promoted to team leader.

words.definition: A plan for how much money will be spent.
words.example: The project is still within budget.

words.definition: A person or company that buys services.
words.example: The client approved our design.

words.definition: A written legal agreement between two parties.
words.example: Both sides signed the contract yesterday.

words.definition: A plan of activities and the times they happen.
words.example: The meeting is on the schedule for Monday.
words.example_id: Rapat itu ada di jadwal hari Senin.

words.definition: A list of things to discuss or do in a meeting.
words.example: The agenda has five items.

words.definition: A short written message inside a company.
words.example: The manager sent a memo about the new policy.
words.example_id: Manajer mengirim memo tentang kebijakan baru.

words.definition: A document that describes facts or results.
words.example: I submitted the monthly report today.
words.example_id: Saya mengumpulkan laporan bulanan hari ini.

words.definition: A time when people come together to discuss things.
words.example: The meeting starts in ten minutes.

words.definition: A formal plan or suggestion.
words.example: We sent the proposal to the client.
words.example_id: Kami mengirim proposal itu ke klien.

words.definition: A company that provides goods to another company.
words.example: Our supplier delivers every Monday.
words.example_id: Pemasok kami mengirim barang setiap Senin.

words.definition: One part of a large organisation.
words.example: She works in the finance department.

words.definition: A person who watches over other workers.
words.example: My supervisor approved the leave request.

words.definition: Someone who is paid to work for a company.
words.example: The company has forty employees.
words.example_id: Perusahaan itu punya empat puluh karyawan.

words.definition: Money paid to someone for their work each month.
words.example: The salary is paid on the 25th.

words.definition: A goal you plan to reach.
words.example: We reached our sales target early.
words.example_id: Kami mencapai target penjualan lebih awal.

words.definition: To start a new product or service.
words.example: They will launch the app next month.
words.example_id: Mereka akan meluncurkan aplikasinya bulan depan.

words.definition: A business relationship between two organisations.
words.example: The partnership lasted five years.

words.definition: A plan to reach a long-term goal.
words.example: The team discussed a new marketing strategy.

words.definition: Money gained after costs are paid.
words.example: The shop made a small profit this month.
words.example_id: Toko itu mendapat laba kecil bulan ini.

words.definition: Money spent on something.
words.example: Travel expenses are paid by the company.

words.definition: Money returned to a customer.
words.example: She asked for a refund for the broken item.
words.example_id: Dia meminta pengembalian uang untuk barang rusak itu.

words.definition: To officially agree to something.
words.example: The director approved our budget.

words.definition: Comments about how good or useful something is.
words.example: Thank you for your honest feedback.
words.example_id: Terima kasih atas masukan jujur Anda.

words.definition: To pay another company to do part of the work.
words.example: Many firms outsource their customer support.

words.definition: To give someone a job.
words.example: We hired two designers this month.
words.example_id: Kami mempekerjakan dua desainer bulan ini.

words.definition: To officially leave your job.
words.example: He resigned after five years.
words.example_id: Dia mengundurkan diri setelah lima tahun.

words.definition: Extra hours worked beyond normal time.
words.example: She worked overtime all week.

words.definition: The amount of work someone must do.
words.example: My workload doubles in December.
words.example_id: Beban kerja saya berlipat pada Desember.

words.definition: Happening every three months.
words.example: The quarterly report is ready.

words.definition: A person or group affected by a project.
words.example: We asked every stakeholder for input.
words.example_id: Kami meminta masukan dari setiap pemangku kepentingan.

words.definition: Working well without wasting time or money.
words.example: The new system improved efficiency.

words.definition: To find new people to join a company.
words.example: They plan to recruit ten engineers.

words.definition: Something that encourages you to do more.
words.example: Bonuses are a strong incentive.

words.definition: A formal request for a job or place.
words.example: She sent her application yesterday.

words.definition: A formal review of someone's work.
words.example: My appraisal is next week.

words.definition: Extra money paid for good performance.
words.example: The team received a year-end bonus.

words.definition: A person being considered for a job.
words.example: We interviewed three candidates.

words.definition: To say that something is definitely true.
words.example: Please confirm the meeting time.

words.definition: To work together towards a goal.
words.example: Both departments must cooperate.

words.definition: Someone who buys goods or services.
words.example: The customer asked for a refund.

words.definition: When two companies become one.
words.example: The merger was announced on Monday.

words.definition: Something you plan to achieve.
words.example: Our objective is to cut costs.

words.definition: A move to a higher position at work.
words.example: He got a promotion after two years.
words.example_id: Dia mendapat promosi setelah dua tahun.

words.definition: Selling goods directly to the public.
words.example: She works in retail.

words.definition: The place where you do your job.
words.example: Safety is important in every workplace.
words.example_id: Keselamatan penting di setiap tempat kerja.

words.definition: An arrangement accepted by both sides.
words.example: Both teams reached an agreement.

words.definition: An official check of financial records.
words.example: The audit starts next week.

words.definition: A local office of a larger company.
words.example: Our branch opens at nine.

words.definition: The buying and selling of goods.
words.example: Digital commerce keeps growing.

words.definition: To try to do better than others.
words.example: Small shops struggle to compete.

words.definition: A person who buys goods for personal use.
words.example: Consumers want faster delivery.

words.definition: A prediction based on data.
words.example: The sales forecast looks positive.

words.definition: The management of moving goods.
words.example: Logistics costs increased sharply.

words.definition: The difference between cost and price.
words.example: Our margin is thin this quarter.

words.definition: Goods sent from one place to another.
words.example: The shipment arrived on time.

words.definition: Working well together as a group.
words.example: Teamwork made the launch smooth.
words.example_id: Kerja sama tim membuat peluncuran lancar.

words.definition: A company that sells goods or services.
words.example: We compared three vendors.
